'''2000 Montana State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Bozeman, MT on 15 April 2000. [[Jeremy LaMere]] won it. It is known from Jeremy LaMere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d542">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-bozeman-mt-4-15-2000-statesd542/ bozeman-mt-4-15-2000-states], DeckTech (Jeremy "jerome" LaMere, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-bozeman-mt-4-15-2000-statesd542/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Bozeman, MT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Jeremy LaMere]]
